title: Establish a scoped Ruff formatting baseline for RepoGround call navigation
goal: Resolve the current pinned-Ruff formatter drift in RepoGround call navigation through one AST-neutral test-file formatting change, then make the exact five-file format gate explicit in CI without changing runtime behavior or upgrading Ruff.

approval.note: Only the one measured formatting file, the lint workflow gate, and its workflow-control-plane identity may change. Ruff upgrades, semantic edits, repository-wide formatting and unrelated cleanup are excluded.

acceptance.assertion: Repository-pinned Ruff 0.15.13 formats and accepts the five current call-navigation files; only merger/repoground/tests/test_call_navigation.py requires a content change on RepoGround main 90255dd02c9a5e4b3718ecdbfa26241b1414c169.

The AST-normalized SHA-256 of the formatted Python file remains fc281b278a1641dccbde35b8dcc216c6f4402f3babca0774368f0200c76c8513, and focused call-navigation tests plus the complete required test suites pass.

The patch changes exactly the one formatted test file, .github/workflows/lint.yml, and config/workflow-control-plane.v1.json; the 95-addition/73-deletion formatter churn is reviewed as style-only and no producer refactor or Ruff upgrade is mixed in.

The lint workflow executes pinned Ruff format --check over the exact five current call-navigation files, and the workflow-control-plane inventory is refreshed so future lint-only runs cannot be mistaken for format validation.

Ruff lint and format checks, focused tests, full non-browser and browser suites, CodeQL, workflow contracts, git diff --check, revision-bound self-review, merge and main readback pass on the exact final head.

metadata.source_finding: Historical Ruff 0.15.13 drift on T029 was remeasured on current RepoGround main: one of five surviving call-navigation files still requires formatting; four are already formatted and historical repobrief_access.py no longer exists.
does_not_establish: permission to change files outside the exact three-path scope
merge readiness before fresh CI and review
